query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `evidence_bibliography_links` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `evidence_id` int NOT NULL,
  `bibliography_id` int NOT NULL,
  `link_type` enum('primary','secondary','methodology','context') DEFAULT 'primary',
  `match_method` enum('doi','title','manual','auto') DEFAULT 'manual',
  `match_score` int,
  `notes` text,
  `verified` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `verified_by` int,
  `verified_at` timestamp,
  `created_by` int,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `evidence_bibliography_links_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  UNIQUE INDEX `unique_evidence_bibliography` (`evidence_id`, `bibliography_id`),
  INDEX `evidence_bibliography_evidence_idx` (`evidence_id`),
  INDEX `evidence_bibliography_bibliography_idx` (`bibliography_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `evidence_bibliography_evidence_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`evidence_id`) REFERENCES `molecule_evidence`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `evidence_bibliography_bibliography_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`bibliography_id`) REFERENCES `bibliography_entries`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `evidence_bibliography_verified_by_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`verified_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `evidence_bibliography_created_by_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`)
);
